sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: L2: surface expression assessed by FLAG immunodetection (result: surface-expressed). L1: cAMP accumulation assay with 10 nM ligand stimulation (result: receptor functional, cAMP signaling preserved).
sites.rationale: PTGDR is a GPCR with no native signal peptide; residues 1–20 form the extracellular N-terminus and TM1 begins at V21, placing the prepend site 20 residues from the first TM boundary (well above the ≥3-residue threshold). L2 explicitly describes the construct architecture as [HA-SP][FLAG][PTGDR], so after HA-SP cleavage the FLAG tag occupies the position immediately before canonical M1, giving insert_after_residue = 0 with residue_after = M (confirmed from sequence). Python confirmed seq[0] = 'M' and total length = 359. The intracellular C-terminus (327–359) is the only other terminus and is not a surface site. L2 (PMC12508460) describes a full-length human PTGDR construct with an exogenous HA signal peptide (KTIIALSYIFCLVFA) followed by a FLAG tag (DYKDDDD) prepended to the receptor; after HA-SP cleavage the FLAG tag sits at the extracellular N-terminus before canonical M1. L1 (PMC3677937) independently reports a Flag-DP1 full-length construct expressed in HEK293 cells with confirmed surface expression and cAMP signaling, corroborating the same N-terminal junction.

sources.claim: The construct includes an N-terminal hemagglutinin (HA) signal peptide (KTIIALSYIFCLVFA) to facilitate cell surface delivery and a Flag-tag epitope (DYKDDDD) for assessing surface expression.

literature_notes: L3 (PMC12508460) describes the same FLAG-at-N-terminus design as L2 in an inactive-state ICL3-bRIL variant; it grounds the same junction and adds no new site. The bRIL thermostabilising domain is inserted into ICL3 (topology: intracellular, residues 220–264) and is not a surface tag site; no specific residue for the bRIL junction is stated in the clip, so it cannot be entered in other_positions. ECL1 (86–106), ECL2 (173–196), and ECL3 (286–305) are extracellular loops that could in principle carry internal tags, but no ledger line reports a tolerated insertion in any of these loops for PTGDR or a close ortholog, so no sites are proposed there.
